prompt: Account A starts with 10 followers and DOUBLES every week. Account B starts with 10 and ADDS 100 every week. After how many weeks does A first have more followers than B?
hint: One account multiplies and the other adds. Write a rule for each and compare them week by week.

hints.text: One account multiplies and the other adds. Write a rule for each and compare them week by week.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Fill two weeks: A goes $10 \to 20 \to 40$ while B goes $10 \to 20 \to 30$. Doubling starts slow, then rockets past adding.
A has $10 \cdot 2^w$ followers and B has $10 + 100w$. At week $5$, A has $320$ and B has $510$, so B still leads. Check week $6$.
At week $6$, A has $640$ and B has $610$, so A first passes B after $6$ weeks.

explanation: Account B is linear because it adds $100$ each week, and account A is exponential because it multiplies by $2$.
Compare them in a table. Week $4$ gives $160$ and $410$, week $5$ gives $320$ and $510$, and week $6$ gives $640$ and $610$.
Week $6$ is the first time A is larger, so the answer is $6$ weeks. Exponential growth always overtakes linear growth in the end.

alternativeExplanations.title: Watch the weekly jumps
steps: B always jumps by exactly 100. A jumps by its whole current size: +160 in week 5, +320 in week 6.
Once A jumps more than 100 per week AND closes the gap, it takes the lead — that happens in week 6 (640 vs 610).

alternativeExplanations.title: Tortoise and rocket
steps: B is a tortoise on a moving walkway: steady +100, a straight line on a graph. A is a rocket: slow at launch, then curving up faster and faster.
The rocket lags for 5 weeks, then blasts past in week 6 and never looks back.
